reviews.author: Yaumelis

reviews.title: Not for long sitting w/o extra cushion.
reviews.body: Great chair , has adjustable height, easy to assemble, comfortable and noise level depends on floor surface. I recommend especially if you’re not sitting long hours. If it’s for your nine to five, you’ll need more cushion. I use for a few hrs at a time before the backside starts to hurt. It’s a bit better if you can find the right cushion.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 26, 2026
reviews.author: Child of Elohim

reviews.title: Good, comfortable chair
reviews.body: This has been pretty much exactly what I hoped. Solid, comfortable, functional. I saw a few comments mentioning it doesn't recline at all, but that isn't the case--you can lean back and it has some give (though yes, it doesn't have a built-in recline thing). The up seat height adjuster works well. Arm handles aren't adjustable in height but that hasn't been an issue for me.To be frank I find myself getting kind of sweaty on the rear end when sitting, but I think any chair that isn't some kind of mesh material on the bottom would give me the same issue. So I don't have any complaints.It's not gonna change your life but for the price, I'm plenty happy with it and will probably use it for however many years until it breaks. Took under an hour to set up and was intuitive as long as you refer to the instructions.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 23, 2026
reviews.author: Ryan Kasparian

reviews.title: Better than expected. 9/10
reviews.body: (Few months of constant use)Actually a great chair, especially for the price. Comfortable, good for sitting for long periods, good posture & looks nice as well.Cons: Can see the cushion flattening out sooner rather than later (maybe) but I like this chair so much I’ll prob just buy another when it wears out.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Quality comfortable
reviews.body: I am honestly so impressed with this pink office chair. It was delivered a day earlier than expected, which was a great surprise. The quality is excellent — sturdy, comfortable, and well-made.I’m 4’11” and about 200 pounds, and the chair fits me perfectly, which can be hard to find. It feels supportive and comfortable, even when sitting for long periods. Assembly was very easy and straightforward; I had it put together in no time.Overall, I am extremely satisfied with this purchase. The color is beautiful, the quality exceeded my expectations, and it’s clear this chair was thoughtfully designed. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-fitting office chair.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 1, 2026
reviews.author: Melanie Forghani

reviews.title: Good, but has issues
reviews.body: Was really frustrating to put together when trying to assemble the arm rest to the chair after having already assembled the seat and back rest together, which is what it says to do in instructions before even attaching armrest to seat. Furthermore the plastic circles that are supposed to cover the areas where we use the hex screws, keep falling off. And don’t stay in place.

reviews.author: Keaton

features: Ergonomic Design: Sweetcrispy Computer Gaming Chair is designed provide optimal comfort support long gaming sessions. Its contoured backrest cushioned seat work together maintain proper posture, reducing fatigue strain the body. The Ergonomic Design ensures that users can sit comfortably extended periods without feeling uncomfortable or restricted

Comfy Materials: The big and tall gaming desk chair with multi-line elements and a hollowed-out back to highlight the design is made of PU leather, which is comfortable and breathable. The cushion is thick and slightly concave to fit the curve of the hip, while the two-color combination design can meet the needs of creating visual and ambient atmospheres. The chair can help you find the most relaxed sitting position suitable for long gaming or work hours

Adjustable Height & Flip-up Armrest: The height of the racing chair is adjustable (adjustment range: 18inch-22inch), and the 90° flip-up armrests help you save space and provide extra support for your arms to relax. When the armrests are flipped up and locked in an upright position, the chair can be easily pushed under the table. Loosen the button underneath the chair to activate a rocking motion

Sturdy and Durable: Our racer gaming chair are made of sturdy chrome-plated metal with a maximum load-bearing of 275 lbs. The base's pentagonal casters are right-angle multi-gimbal wheels, which can ensure the stability and mobility of the chair. The silent multi-direction casters can swivel 360 degrees while protecting the floor

Easy to Assemble: The pc gaming chair comes with all hardware & necessary tools and can be installed within 15 minutes. It can be quickly installed at home by yourself. We also have a professional customer service team, so if you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us
